what_it_does: This is a power amplifier for millimeter-wave radio (56–64 GHz, used in 5G and satellite communications) that generates strong, clean signals at very high efficiency. The design tackles a fundamental challenge: combining power from multiple small amplifier cores into one strong output signal. As you add more cores, the impedance mismatch (a mismatch in electrical "resistance") grows and signal-routing losses increase. This design uses a radial combining geometry to reduce these losses and a novel technique that keeps the impedance stable regardless of how many cores are combined together.
